_comment: Reviewed Wikidata QID overrides for names that automatic search cannot resolve safely (mononyms colliding with places/given names, or shared names where sitelink count picks the wrong person). Each entry is hand-verified against date of birth, nationality, position, and expected clubs. The collector trusts these values and fetches the given enwiki_title for the career table.

Xavi.reason: Mononym: Wikidata search for 'Xavi' returns the given-name item, an Italian municipality, and researchers, not the footballer. Verified as Xavier Hernandez Creus (Q17500), b.1980-01-25, Spain, central midfielder for Barcelona; enwiki page 'Xavi' redirects to 'Xavi (footballer, born 1980)'.

Gavi.reason: Mononym: 'Gavi' collides with a Piedmont municipality, the vaccine alliance GAVI, and given names. Verified as Pablo Martin Paez Gavira (Q108111889), b.2004-08-05, Spain, midfielder for Barcelona.

Jorginho.reason: Shared name: automatic resolution picked the 1964 Brazilian Jorginho (Q163750) because it has more sitelinks. The roster means the Italy international Jorge Luiz Frello Filho (Q3810078), b.1991-12-20, deep-lying midfielder for Napoli/Chelsea/Arsenal.

Bernardo Silva.reason: Automatic resolution reached the correct entity (Q15521306) but flagged it ambiguous against namesakes (Bernardo b.1965, Bernardo Silva b.2001). Confirmed as Bernardo Mota Veiga de Carvalho e Silva, b.1994-08-10, Portugal, Manchester City midfielder.
